⇅

Data & backup

Everything you log lives in your account. Keep a copy for safety or to move devices.

A backup includes habits, workouts, meals, water, vitals, measurements, goals, your meal & ingredient library and profile settings. Importing replaces current data — a safety copy is downloaded first.

⚠

Danger zone

These actions can’t be undone. Export a backup first.

Clear today’s dataRemoves today’s meals, exercises, water and habit check-ins. History and settings stay.
Reset all dataWipes every log, habit, goal and library entry. Your account stays.
Delete profilePermanently deletes your user ID, password and ALL data from the database, then signs you out. You can register again with any User ID — including this one.

Notes
  • Metrics are computed live from the fitos_users collection — no placeholder numbers
  • "Plan" and "Pro/Free split" are not shown yet — no subscription/plan system exists in the database (Phase 3)
  • Account status enforcement (suspended → blocked login) is a client-side check on login, since this project has no server/Cloud Functions layer — noted under each suspended user
    • Users
    Loading users…
    Content Management
  • Global content is separate from each user's personal library — adding items here never touches user data.
  • Stored under admin/content as structured arrays, validated before save (no raw HTML/JS accepted).
    • Payments & Subscriptions
  • Customers submit a bKash / Nagad Transaction ID from the website checkout. They get provisional Pro access immediately.
  • Check the TrxID in your bKash / Nagad app (amount + sender number), then press VERIFY. The user is notified inside the app and Pro is confirmed for the full plan period.
  • REJECT ends their provisional access and shows them a message so they can re-submit.
    • Loading payments…
    Main Ingredient Library
  • This is the main library — every user sees these ingredients (read-only) inside their Ingredient Library and meal search.
  • Ingredients users add themselves stay private to that user and never appear here or for other users.
  • Stored under global/ingredientLibrary (readable by signed-in users, writable only by the owner via Security Rules).
    • Add Ingredient
    Ingredients
    Loading…
    Workout Library
  • The app already ships with 140 built-in exercise templates (10 per body part, with form guides).
  • Templates you add here are shown to every user (read-only, marked MAIN) in Fitness → Workout → Templates.
  • Stored under global/workoutLibrary (readable by signed-in users, writable only by the owner).

    Feature Flags
  • The frontend must treat a missing/unreadable flag as disabled (fail safe) — see isFeatureEnabled().
    • Loading flags…
    Plans & Limits
  • No payment processing exists — this controls limits only. Billing fields are placeholders for a future provider integration.
  • Limits are enforced by getPlanLimit() in the app layer, not just hidden in the UI.
